tools.name: transcribe_video
tools.description: Submit a video URL for transcription and wait for the result. Supports Instagram Reels/Posts, TikTok videos, YouTube videos/Shorts, and Facebook videos/Reels. Costs 1 credit. Returns the full transcription when complete. There is no storage quota, so a submission is never rejected for having too many saved transcriptions.

url.description: Video URL (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, or Facebook)

tools.name: get_transcription
tools.description: Get a transcription by its ID or requestId. Returns the full transcription text when completed, or status/error info if still processing or failed.

tools.name: list_transcriptions
tools.description: List ONE PAGE of your transcriptions, newest first (default 20, max 200). This is a page, not a count of the library: the API does not report a library total, so never present the number of rows returned as the number of transcriptions the user has. When `hasMore` is true, more pages exist — pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor`. Only when `libraryTotal` is non-null is the count complete. Transcripts are returned as previews; use get_transcription with an id for the full text, or get_credits for a library-wide count of completed transcriptions.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from a previous call, to fetch the following page

tools.name: search_transcriptions
tools.description: Find transcriptions whose original video URL contains the given string. Returns the newest match in full, plus ids of any other matches. Useful for checking whether a video has already been transcribed. The search covers a bounded window of your most recent transcriptions and returns a capped number of matches, so `found: false` means "not found in that window" — it does not prove the video was never transcribed, and `matchesReturned` is not a library-wide count.

url.description: The video URL to search for

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Check your ReelScribe credit balance, subscription tier, how many completed transcriptions are stored, and how long they are kept. Each transcription costs 1 credit. There is no storage quota — a library is bounded by time (see `retention`), not by a count limit. `library.completedTranscriptions` is a bounded count: when `library.isCapped` is true the real number is higher, so quote it as "N+".

tools.name: validate_url
tools.description: Check if a URL is a supported video platform (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook) without submitting for transcription. Returns the detected platform and normalized URL.
